model: Task-trained BERT, four layers / 11.1M parameters; cascade adds separate two-layer / 4.37M BERT

cascade.scope: Illustrative conservative cutoff for the exported tiny model with four-layer BERT fallback; not the published tiny-to-Qwen cascade and not calibrated for this pairing.

limitations: Consumed real-message sample, not a fresh accuracy test.
Timing includes tokenization, inference, checks and output reading. Setup/download/warmup excluded. Two reverse-order passes; device-specific.
Cascade is a new BERT-to-BERT illustration; fallback repeats input encoding. 2+4 blocks are not equivalent FLOPs because widths differ.
Training mode runs existing trained weights, not browser training. Quantization mode converts BERT, not the Qwen experiment.
Only adaptive/fixed modes skip layers inside the four-layer model.
